title: Unlocking value across the Central Corridor
summary: Leaders discuss how connectivity across assets, teams and markets creates value from Canada to the Gulf Coast.
body_markdown:
Leaders discuss how connectivity across assets, teams and markets creates value from Canada to the Gulf Coast


This Today & Tomorrow episode explores how teams work together to optimize crude supply, move products to the highest-value markets and strengthen the company’s competitive position through integration.


In the video below, leaders dive into this connected system where collaboration and flexibility help unlock opportunities across the value chain.


***Featuring, left to right:*** *Todd Tanory, SVP, midstream operations;* *Chris Gallo, SVP, regional refining;* *Ronald Sanchez, VP, lubricants and specialties;* *Ryan Ebright, senior director, branded sales; and* *Mark Senn, SVP, global trading.*


VIDEO HIGHLIGHTS


**Built for opportunity**


How are these connected assets helping Phillips 66 create flexibility to meet changing market demands?
